integrity: Constructive general proof included. Finite exact-arithmetic tests are supporting evidence only. Literature comparison does not certify absolute novelty; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only complete multipartite item-conflict graphs and three agents with one common normalized monotone valuation are covered. Maximal feasible allocation need not be complete or EFX. The four-agent obstruction is known prior work; first-public date refers to the motivating three-agent research gap, not to a publication of the present theorem.
title: The sharp three-agent frontier for maximal EF1 on complete multipartite conflict graphs
